overall: Checker is clean (396/396 items pass, all 134 tokens covered) and the class calls are sound: the 12 exclusives are gun-only words and none of the multi tokens is really gun-only. Neutrality is mostly good; items lean on gun-derived idioms (jump the gun, riding shotgun, bite the bullet) only for their everyday meaning, which is acceptable, but the 'barre'/'barrel' double-barreled items can be answered from the gun image and need recasting. The main recurring problems are giveaways where the answer is echoed in the question (eight-ball, glassmaking/molten glass, eject/ejection seat, Arthurian/Arthur, quartet/4), obscure trivia for a 2B model (Woodbine Racetrack, Muskegon, Gunma, Heckle and Jeckle, Heck cattle, Pistol Star, 'deject'), and repeated contexts within a token (three Guns N' Roses items, three Ottoman-history items, two ostrich, two nuclear-weapon, two 'pear shaped'). Forced capitalization to hit no-space tokens is unacceptable for common nouns ('"Barrel roll"', '"Colt" in horse breeding', mid-sentence 'Glockenspiel'); quoting proper names or titles is tolerated. Many multi tokens have fewer than 4 items where more are easy (e.g. Shar Pei, spearhead, cocked an eyebrow, water cannons, projectile vomiting); fill those.
